01  How I work

Talk first. Then ship the whole thing.

The best tools I've built started as a conversation with sales, ops or customer service. I like that part as much as the code.

Listen

Start with the people

I map how a team really works before I write anything. Ask the Advisor came from sitting with internal teams and tracing every request by hand.

Build

Own it end to end

React and Next.js up front, Node, SQL and AWS behind it. I take a problem from the first sketch to production and keep it running.

Show

Demo it live

I run demos and training sessions for Sales and Marketing whenever something new ships. A feature nobody adopts isn't finished.

02  My app

Squadle

Organize your squad. Show up and play.

Group chats are a bad way to run a pickup game. Squadle gives every group one place to schedule games, collect money and see who's actually showing up. I designed, built and launched it myself in 2026.

  • ScheduleA calendar-driven interface and shareable invite links make creating a game and joining one take seconds.
  • PaymentsVenmo integration collects from players automatically for every game.
  • StatsWins, attendance and games per month, which also steer what I build next.
  • PlansFree and paid tiers with admin tools for the people running each group.
